title: AdFection: Targeted ads turned into a pipeline for zero-click mercenary spyware
why_read: A serious investigative piece on how ad-tech infrastructure can be abused to deliver zero-click spyware, relevant to anyone working in security or ad-tech.
analysis: The title describes an investigation into how targeted advertising systems can serve as a delivery mechanism for 'zero-click mercenary spyware', meaning malware that infects a device without any user interaction. This connects two areas of real technical concern: the opaque, programmatic ad-bidding pipeline and the exploit market for mobile and desktop zero-days. If accurate, this is a meaningful security story because it highlights an underappreciated attack surface that ordinary users can't defend against. The high comment count suggests substantial discussion, likely debating technical plausibility and mitigations.
